answer.identity_notes: The target is Ultraman: The Ultimate Hero (Ultraman Powered), a live-action tokusatsu series co-produced by Tsuburaya Productions and a US company. It is not an anime. The first Japanese video release was in 1993, preceding its TV broadcast in 1995.
